name: langwatch
description_en: Open-Source Agent Observability & Evals for AI Platform teams. Trace, test, route and govern every agent & coding assistant in the company.
readme_excerpt: LangWatch is the open-source platform for AI in production: trace, test, route and govern every LLM call in your company, from the agents you build to the coding assistants your engineers use. LangWatch is Apache 2.0. View docs. Get started LangWatch Cloud Track your coding agents Self-host Only Node.js required. For production, see Self-hosting LangWatch.
